records.jp: あっ、美弦さん見て見て！<CR>花壇のとこ、何かの芽が出てるよ
records.en_original: Mio, look! The flowers here are starting to bud.
records.en_auxiliary: Mio, look! The flowers here are starting to bud.
records.en: Mio-san, look!<CR>Some kind of sprouts are coming up in the flower bed.

records.jp: あら、本当ね。<CR>何の芽かしら？
records.en_original: Oh, you're right. I wonder what they'll grow into.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, you're right. I wonder what they'll grow into.
records.en: Oh, you're right.<CR>What kind of sprouts could they be?

records.jp: 雑草かな？
records.en_original: I wonder if they're just weeds?
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder if they're just weeds?
records.en: I wonder if they're just weeds?

records.jp: 雑草なら、こんなふうに<CR>同じような芽が等間隔で生えるかしら？
records.en_original: I don't think weeds would spread themselves out so evenly like this.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think weeds would spread themselves out so evenly like this.
records.en: I don't think weeds would<CR>spread themselves out so evenly like this.

records.jp: 明らかに人の手を感じるわ。<CR>きっと誰かが植えたのね
records.en_original: It looks quite clear that these haven't grown by themselves. Someone planted them.
records.en_auxiliary: It looks quite clear that these haven't grown by themselves. Someone planted them.
records.en: It looks quite clear that these haven't grown by themselves.<CR>Someone planted them.

records.jp: そう言われてみれば、<CR>こういう花の芽、どこかで見たことあるような……
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, I do get the feeling I've seen a flower like this before…
records.en_auxiliary: Now that you mention it, I do get the feeling I've seen a flower like this before…
records.en: Now that you mention it,<CR>I feel like I've seen sprouts like these somewhere...

records.jp: そうね……これ、チューリップじゃないかしら？<CR>思えば、幼い頃に植えたことがあったから
records.en_original: Hmm... I wonder if they're tulips? I remember planting some when I was young.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I wonder if they're tulips? I remember planting some when I was young.
records.en: Yes... Could they be tulips? Come to think of it,<CR>I planted some when I was little.

records.jp: なるほど、さすがの観察眼！<CR>名探偵美弦さんだ……！
records.en_original: Oooh, sharp eyes! Detective Mio, on the case!
records.en_auxiliary: Oooh, sharp eyes! Detective Mio, on the case!
records.en: Oooh, sharp eyes!<CR>Detective Mio-san, on the case!

records.jp: お花の芽かな？
records.en_original: I bet they're flowers.
records.en_auxiliary: I bet they're flowers.
records.en: I bet they're flowers.

records.jp: きっとそうね。<CR>この前植えた球根が、芽を出したんだわ
records.en_original: I think you're right. Looks like those bulbs I planted before are starting to grow.
records.en_auxiliary: I think you're right. Looks like those bulbs I planted before are starting to grow.
records.en: I think you're right.<CR>Looks like those bulbs I planted before are starting to grow.

records.jp: チューリップだね！
records.en_original: Tulips, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Tulips, right?
records.en: Tulips, right?

records.jp: 確か……こっちの芽が黄色い花で、<CR>こっちのは赤い花を咲かせるんだったかしら
records.en_original: I believe these ones here are yellow, and these are red.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe these ones here are yellow, and these are red.
records.en: I believe these ones here are yellow,<CR>and these are red.

records.jp: そんなことまで覚えてるの！？
records.en_original: You remember all of that?!
records.en_auxiliary: You remember all of that?!
records.en: You remember all of that?!

records.jp: た、たまたまね。<CR>偶然、なんとなく覚えてただけよ
records.en_original: I-I just happened to recall.
records.en_auxiliary: I-I just happened to recall.
records.en: I-I just<CR>happened to recall.

records.jp: （美弦さん、ちょっと照れてる……？<CR>　本当は、花が咲くのをすごく楽しみにしてるのかも）
records.en_original: (Is Mio...blushing? I wonder if she's embarrassed of how excited she is for these flowers.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Is Mio...blushing? I wonder if she's embarrassed of how excited she is for these flowers.)
records.en: (Mio-san is blushing a little...?<CR>Maybe she's really looking forward to the flowers blooming.)

records.jp: 美弦さんって、お花が好きなの？
records.en_original: Do you like flowers, Mio?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you like flowers, Mio?
records.en: Do you like flowers, Mio-san?

records.jp: 好きよ。<CR>綺麗な花を見ていると、心が休まるもの
records.en_original: I do. Beautiful flowers soothe the soul.
records.en_auxiliary: I do. Beautiful flowers soothe the soul.
records.en: I do.<CR>Beautiful flowers soothe the soul.

records.jp: 私もお花、好きだなあ
records.en_original: I like them too.
records.en_auxiliary: I like them too.
records.en: I like them too.

records.jp: ふふ、私とお揃いね
records.en_original: Hehe, it seems we're the same.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, it seems we're the same.
records.en: Hehe, it seems we're the same.

records.jp: 美弦さんとお揃い！<CR>それ、なんだかドキドキするかも
records.en_original: I'm the same as Mio? I can't believe it...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm the same as Mio? I can't believe it...
records.en: I'm the same as Mio-san!<CR>That makes my heart race a little.

records.jp: あら、喜んではくれないの？
records.en_original: Oh, would you prefer not to be?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, would you prefer not to be?
records.en: Oh, would you prefer not to be?

records.jp: もちろん喜んでるよ！<CR>嬉しくって、ドキドキってこと！
records.en_original: No, I'm flattered! My heart's racing just thinking about it!
records.en_auxiliary: No, I'm flattered! My heart's racing just thinking about it!
records.en: No, I'm flattered!<CR>My heart's racing just thinking about it!

records.jp: 私は、どっちかっていうと、心が休まるというより<CR>不安になることが多いかも
records.en_original: If anything, the stress me out a little, I think.
records.en_auxiliary: If anything, the stress me out a little, I think.
records.en: For me, rather than soothing me,<CR>flowers might make me anxious more often.

records.jp: あら、どうして？
records.en_original: Oh, my. Is that so?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, my. Is that so?
records.en: Oh? Why?

records.jp: だってこの芽を見てると、『ちゃんと咲くかな？』<CR>『水は足りてるかな』って、ハラハラしちゃうから
records.en_original: Whenever I see stuff like this, all I feel is worried about if they're getting enough water, or if they'll bloom at all.
records.en_auxiliary: Whenever I see stuff like this, all I feel is worried about if they're getting enough water, or if they'll bloom at all.
records.en: Because when I see these sprouts,<CR>I worry, 'Will they bloom properly?' and 'Do they have enough water?'

records.jp: ハラハラ、ね……<CR>それって本当にハラハラだけなのかしら？
records.en_original: I see...? Are you sure that's all it is?
records.en_auxiliary: I see...? Are you sure that's all it is?
records.en: Anxious, you say...<CR>Is that really all it is?

records.jp: え？　どういうこと？
records.en_original: Huh? What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What do you mean?
records.en: Huh? What do you mean?

records.jp: 花を心配する、愛央の気持ちには……
records.en_original: That worry you feel for the flowers...
records.en_auxiliary: That worry you feel for the flowers...
records.en: That worry you feel for the flowers...

records.jp: 花を楽しみにする<CR>ワクワクも混ざってるんじゃないかってこと
records.en_original: Isn't that partly because you're excited to see them bloom?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't that partly because you're excited to see them bloom?
records.en: I mean that your concern for the flowers<CR>might also contain excitement about seeing them bloom.

records.jp: あ……！<CR>言われてみれば、そうかもしれない
records.en_original: Huh...! You know, you might be right.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...! You know, you might be right.
records.en: Huh...!<CR>You know, you might be right.

records.jp: 美弦さんと一緒だと、<CR>お花を眺めるだけでドキドキワクワクするなあ
records.en_original: I don't think I'd enjoy looking at flowers as much as this without you here.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think I'd enjoy looking at flowers as much as this without you here.
records.en: When I'm with you,<CR>Mio-san, even just looking at flowers makes my heart race with excitement.

records.jp: ふふ、光栄ね
records.en_original: Hehe... I'm honored.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... I'm honored.
records.en: Hehe... I'm honored.

records.jp: （美弦さんと、もう少しだけ一緒にいたいな。<CR>　……あ、そうだ！）
records.en_original: (I'd like to stay here with Mio a bit longer... Oh, that's right!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'd like to stay here with Mio a bit longer... Oh, that's right!)
records.en: (I'd like to stay here with Mio-san a bit longer...<CR>Oh, that's right!)

records.jp: ねえ美弦さん、<CR>一緒に、お花にお水をあげようよ
records.en_original: Want to water the flowers together?
records.en_auxiliary: Want to water the flowers together?
records.en: Hey, Mio-san,<CR>let's water the flowers together.

records.jp: 一緒に？　……そうね。<CR>見たところ、土も乾いているし……
records.en_original: Together with you? Yes, looking now, the soil does look a tad dry.
records.en_auxiliary: Together with you? Yes, looking now, the soil does look a tad dry.
records.en: Together? ...Yes.<CR>The soil does look dry...

records.jp: 今日の水やりはまだみたいね。<CR>いいわ、一緒に水やりしましょうか
records.en_original: It looks like they haven't been watered today. Let's do it.
records.en_auxiliary: It looks like they haven't been watered today. Let's do it.
records.en: They don't seem to have been watered today.<CR>All right, let's water them together.

records.jp: やったあ！<CR>私、ジョウロ取ってくるね！
records.en_original: Whoo-hoo! I'll go get the watering can!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoo-hoo! I'll go get the watering can!
records.en: Whoo-hoo!<CR>I'll go get the watering can!

records.jp: 気をつけてね。<CR>……って、もうあんなに遠くまで行っちゃった
records.en_original: Be careful! ...And there she goes...
records.en_auxiliary: Be careful! ...And there she goes...
records.en: Be careful!<CR>...And there she goes...

records.jp: 水やりが、そんなに楽しみなのかしら。
records.en_original: She's quite fired up about watering.
records.en_auxiliary: She's quite fired up about watering.
records.en: Does she enjoy watering them that much?

records.jp: 今度から、花のお世話をするときは<CR>あの子を誘ってみてもいいかもしれないわね
records.en_original: Maybe I'll start inviting her to take care of the flowers with me.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe I'll start inviting her to take care of the flowers with me.
records.en: Maybe I'll start inviting her<CR>to take care of the flowers with me.

records.jp: あのね、美弦さん<CR>……ちょっと耳貸して？
records.en_original: Mio, can I ask you something?
records.en_auxiliary: Mio, can I ask you something?
records.en: Mio-san...<CR>could you lend me your ear?

records.jp: みんなに内緒で、<CR>ふたりだけの花壇を作らない？
records.en_original: Want to make a special flower garden with just you and me? It'll be our secret.
records.en_auxiliary: Want to make a special flower garden with just you and me? It'll be our secret.
records.en: Why don't we secretly<CR>make a flower bed just for the two of us?

records.jp: みんなに内緒で？<CR>愛央ってば悪い子ね
records.en_original: A secret? Aren't you bad, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: A secret? Aren't you bad, Ao.
records.en: Secretly from everyone?<CR>Ao, you really are a bad girl.

records.jp: ……やっぱり、ダメ？
records.en_original: ...Is that a no?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Is that a no?
records.en: ...Is that a no?

records.jp: そうねえ……勝手に花壇を作るのはダメだけど、<CR>花壇の隅に花を植えるくらいなら
records.en_original: Well... Using a plot just for ourselves wouldn't be good, but we could use the corner of this one.
records.en_auxiliary: Well... Using a plot just for ourselves wouldn't be good, but we could use the corner of this one.
records.en: Well... We shouldn't make a flower bed without permission,<CR>but planting some flowers in the corner of this one would be fine.

records.jp: ほ、ほんと！？
records.en_original: Y-you mean it?!
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you mean it?!
records.en: Y-you mean it?!

records.jp: 嘘をつく理由がないでしょう。<CR>愛央はどんな花を植えたい？
records.en_original: Of course. What kind of flowers would you like to plant?
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. What kind of flowers would you like to plant?
records.en: Why would I lie?<CR>What kind of flowers would you like to plant, Ao?

records.jp: えーっと、ええと……！
records.en_original: Uhhh... Umm...
records.en_auxiliary: Uhhh... Umm...
records.en: Uhhh... Umm...

records.jp: 慌てなくていいわ。<CR>ふたりで、ゆっくり考えましょう
records.en_original: You don't need to decide now. We can take our time and think it over together.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't need to decide now. We can take our time and think it over together.
records.en: You don't need to decide now.<CR>We can take our time and think it over together.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
